faithful_paraphrase: The opened Python Source Releases page labels Python 3.14.7 as the latest Python 3 release and dates it August 5, 2026.
The CPython Developer Guide lists main/3.16 as feature development, 3.15 as prerelease, 3.14 and 3.13 in bugfix, and 3.12, 3.11, and 3.10 in security status; 3.9 is end-of-life.
